settings.unsavedMessage: Settings have unsaved changes. Save them to apply them when debugging.

prompt.systemPlaceholder: System prompt. You can reference these system variables: {data} contains segments retrieved from knowledge; {question} is the user's question; {memory} contains user memory after long-term memory is enabled.
prompt.userPlaceholder: User prompt. You can reference these system variables: {data} contains segments retrieved from knowledge; {question} is the user's question.

noReferences.label: When no knowledge segments are referenced
noReferences.defaultValue: Hello, I'm the XXX assistant. My knowledge only covers the XXX product. Please rephrase your question.

problemOptimization.label: Question optimization
problemOptimization.defaultValue: The text in () is the user's question. Use the conversation context to infer the user's intended question ({question}). Output one complete question enclosed in {dataTags} tags.

prologue.label: Prologue
prologue.defaultValue:
Hello, I'm the XXX assistant. You can ask me questions about using XXX.
- What are the main features of XXX?
- How is XXX priced?
- I need to speak to a human agent

longTermMemory.label: Long-term memory
longTermMemory.title: Long-term memory settings
longTermMemory.description: When enabled, new conversations are recorded from that point onward and periodically summarized into memory. Use the {memory} variable in the system prompt to access it. Disabling this clears chat users' long-term memory. Re-enabling it starts collecting conversations again from that point.

trigger.label: Trigger method
trigger.roundsDescription: After N rounds, automatically summarize those N conversation rounds to generate memory.
trigger.scheduledDescription: At the scheduled time, automatically summarize all conversations within the period to generate memory.

rounds.label: Trigger interval
rounds.invalidMessage: Enter a whole number of rounds between 5 and 100

fileUpload.label: File upload
fileUpload.title: File upload settings
fileUpload.description: When enabled, a file upload button appears on the chat page.

method.label: Upload method
method.requiredMessage: At least one upload method is required
